questions.stem: What type of feedback mechanism controls the release of oxytocin during labour?

options.text: Positive feedback, where the response increases the stimulus
Homeostatic feedback, where conditions stay the same
Negative feedback, where the response reduces the stimulus
Hormonal feedback, where hormones are broken down

questions.explanation: Oxytocin release during labour is controlled by positive feedback. Contractions stimulate more oxytocin release, which causes stronger contractions, which stimulates even more oxytocin, until the baby is born.
